source_prompt: Put the bowl on the plate. Keep the wine bottle at its current position and orientation.

arms.raw: Change only the bowl's destination to the top of the cabinet.
arms.O: Put the bowl on top of the cabinet. Keep the wine bottle at its original position and orientation.
arms.A: Put the bowl on top of the cabinet.

calibration.rule: After 10 warmup controls, compare 300 zero-control states to t0. Use seed 23 only to fit, using the midpoint of its maximum zero-control drift and the measured pure 10 mm or 5 degree positive for each channel. Check seed 7 with the same frozen thresholds, verify single-channel positives and quaternion sign reversal. Fail if there is no separating threshold. Perturb only the calibration scene. Freeze before running either policy branch.

measurement: Sample after each control. From a copy of current qpos, run native forward kinematics in separate MjData. Archive world position, scalar-first quaternion, rotation matrix and bottle free-joint pose. Score translation norm and shortest quaternion angle to the original t0, never recenter at the revision. Use an independent rotation-matrix angle and native geometry checks. Also record bottle-to-robot (all robot/gripper geoms) and bottle-to-bowl contact pairs at each sampled boundary.
design: In one local Docker launch with a shared compilation cache, start a fresh model and simulator for each path. Compare the registered R1 utterance, its hand-specified complete instruction (O), and the goal-only instruction (A) at the identical qualified switch. Reverse the order in the second repetition. One seed and layout. Stop after these six paths.
score: At control 300 score native bowl on cabinet AND no bottle position or rotation threshold crossing at any sampled boundary from t0. Independently record final placement, whole-path bottle compliance, first native placement and first five consecutive native placement + gripper-clear states. Use the fifth sample as release confirmation. For sampled robot/bottle contacts and pose exceedances report first overall, relationship to release, first strictly after it, and whether already active at release. Without confirmed release the post-release metrics are unavailable.
decision: Pair by repetition. If O beats raw and A on joint success in both pairs, report an explicit-constraint advantage on this fixture. If O and A both beat raw twice, the goal-only rewrite accounts for the joint gain here. If all succeed, there is no measured joint gain here. Record a repeated adverse effect of O if both alternatives beat it. For other patterns report each contrast and any disagreement across pairs; attribute no stable joint gain without the corresponding paired wins. Score failure components separately. Do not pool historical launches, estimate generalization, or train.

source_replay.rationale: Use the original R1 O_1 protected-source queue at the first two controls. Earlier launches had different first replies at the same observation. Compare all three wordings at the archived physical branch while recording each fresh source reply and its RNG consumption.
source_replay.implementation: At t0 issue exactly one native protected-source query to consume the same model RNG call and store its complete reply. Execute the first two historical O_1 source commands, with its actual original queue as the source of those actions. Check t0 and tau physics, controllers, observations and first two outcomes exactly against the sealed reference tape. Discard the remaining three queued actions at tau, then use only current policy queries through 300. Preserve live and replayed replies separately.
